title: OSH Park 4 layer, FR408-HR (standard)
checkout: Keep the standard FR408-HR substrate. Do not pick the EM528 alternate offered at checkout since 2026-09-21 when the board has RF structures designed for FR408-HR. On arrival the core should be milky white (EM528 is red).

layers.src: O-4l-stack (construction drawing: 0.6 +/- 0.2 mil, Dk 3.90, Df 0.033 as OSH Park's impedance-model values; the Taiyo data sheet gives Dk 4.5 and Df 0.029 at 1 MHz)

layers.name: F.Cu
layers.src: O-4l (1.7 mil finished: 0.5 oz base plus plating)
O-4l and O-4l-stack (7.87 +/- 0.797 mil; Dk 3.61 at 1 GHz, Df 0.009 from the construction drawing)
O-4l and O-4l-stack (39 +/- 3.9 mil; Dk 3.87, Df 0.009 from the construction drawing, frequency not stated)
O-4l and O-4l-stack (as the L1-L2 prepreg)

tolerances.impedance_note: No impedance-control service. OSH Park's impedance constraint table gives predicted widths against a +/-10 % target band (50 ohm on L1: 15.0 mil, masked, predicted 49.8 ohm); nothing is tested or guaranteed.

frequency_data.material: Isola FR408HR, typical, construction and resin content not stated
frequency_data.src: O-fr408 (data sheet hosted by OSH Park, rev. C 2019)

rf.schema_note: Proposed block for yapnr.rf and the coupon generator (Order 0 design, 2026-10-02). Two regions: M is L1 microstrip over In1.Cu; W is L1 over B.Cu with In1.Cu and In2.Cu removed under the structure. The solver takes one uniform substrate per region.

M.src: derived: Dk 3.61 at 1 GHz scaled by the Isola 1 -> 5 GHz trend (3.64 / 3.69); Df between the drawing's 0.009 and Isola's 0.0098 at 5 GHz; 2-pixel rules at 0.1 mm (OSH minimum 0.127 mm); 0.40 mm = 4 cells is 50.3 ohm with 43 um copper and 53.5 ohm as a zero-thickness sheet

W.src: derived: series combination of 2 x 0.1999 mm prepreg (3.56 at 5 GHz) and 0.9906 mm core (3.87 scaled to 3.82); height = dielectrics only (resin fills the removed inner copper); 3.0 mm = 6 cells is the 50 ohm line

rf.mask_policy: open over all RF copper (the solver has no mask model); one masked coupon measures the mask
rf.copper_model: the solver uses a zero-thickness sheet; t/h is 0.22 on M and 0.03 on W, so M carries a known bias that the coupons measure

notes: Standard FR408HR 4-layer production is on hold until 2026-10-08 (O-home banner, read 2026-10-02).

OSH Park has substituted cores before: an EM528 core under FR408HR prepreg (2026-06-09 to 2026-06-22) and EM528 throughout (2025-12-20 to 2026-01-28). L1-over-In1 structures barely notice the core; W-region structures do.
Values marked derived in the rf block are planning values for the Order 0 runs; the coupon fit replaces them.
